breaking_changes.BC_description: Excess command-arguments now cause an error by default, as 'allowExcessArguments' is set to false by default. Previously, extra arguments were silently accepted.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: To adapt, declare expected arguments using 'program.argument()' or suppress the error with 'program.allowExcessArguments()'. Example: Before: program.parse() without argument declaration. After: program.argument('[args...]', 'description') or program.allowExcessArguments().

breaking_changes.BC_description: Throw an error during Option construction for unsupported option flags, such as multiple characters after a single '-', which were previously allowed.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Ensure option flags are valid. Example: Before: new Option('-abc', 'description'). After: Use valid flags like '-a', '--abc' instead of invalid ones like '-abc'.

breaking_changes.BC_description: Throw an error on multiple calls to '.parse()' if 'storeOptionsAsProperties' is true, which was previously allowed but could cause issues.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Avoid multiple calls to '.parse()' when 'storeOptionsAsProperties' is true, or set it to false. Example: Before: program.parse(); program.parse(); After: Call '.parse()' only once or use 'storeOptionsAsProperties: false'.

breaking_changes.BC_description: 'Help.wrap()' method has been refactored into 'formatItem()' and 'boxWrap()', making the old method unavailable.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Replace calls to 'Help.wrap()' with 'Help.formatItem()' or 'Help.boxWrap()' as appropriate. Example: Before: helpInstance.wrap(text). After: Use helpInstance.formatItem(text) or helpInstance.boxWrap(text) based on the specific use case.
breaking_changes.RequireInfo: The exact differences between 'formatItem()' and 'boxWrap()' are not specified in the provided content. Clarification is needed on when to use each method and any parameter changes.
